# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE_WINDOW_ADJUST

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The original MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE (11:30-14:00 ET) shows strong performance but may miss evolving intraday structure shifts. Shifting the window earlier (11:00-13:30 ET) could better capture midday trend continuations that occur before typical lunch-hour chop, improving edge on bearish rejection days while maintaining loser avoidance.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** Same as MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE — single-trigger trendline_rejection entries in the new window (11:00-13:30 ET).
- **Exit logic:** Unchanged — chart-stop-primary with chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), TP1 at +50% (2/3 qty), runner to breakeven after TP1, full exit on ribbon re-entry or 15:50 ET time stop.
- **Activation:** Only active when `midday_trendline_gate=true` in params.json; window adjusted via new parameter `midday_trendline_window_start_et` (11:00) and `midday_trendline_window_end_et` (13:30).
